notes.title: Praesidium Launch Update
notes.content:
Praesidium has now launched out of Early Access! Multiple improvements have been made:

[list]
[*] All levels have been greatly overhauled with better layouts and improved lighting
[*] Several new assets have been added throughout the environments including new turret models
[*] New and original music tracks have been added to each level and the menus
[*] Countdown intros have been added to each level with a skip option within the Options menu
[*] Menus have been been updated with a new Controls screen
[*] Button prompts have been added to the tutorial to teach players the game's controls
[*] Multiple bugs have been fixed and performance has improved
[/list]

We hope you enjoy this new update and thank you for playing!

notes.title: Praesidium Lighting & UI Update
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Improved lighting throughout levels
[*] Added new emissive light assets throughout level environments
[*] Button positions fixed within tutorial
[*] New UI elements added to menu with sound effects
[*] Frame added to in-game timer
[*] CTRL or C now trigger a roll instead of crouching
[*] Credits screen added

[*] Multiple bugs fixed
[/list]

notes.title: Praesidium Update
notes.content:
This new update brings multiple improvements to Praesidium:
[list]
[*] Environments have been overhauled with new level assets and updated lighting
[*] A tutorial level has been added to teach players Praesidium's shield mechanics
[*] Audio sliders have been added to the menu for both SFX and Music
[*] A toggle UI option has been added to the menu to disable the game's HUD for screenshots
[*] Your best times are now saved persistently within the game
[/list]
